approaches.title: Build the exact top-free constraint-to-automata pipeline

approaches.title: Complete the converse with regular annotations
approaches.summary: Every k-state terminal-final binary abstract instance has an exact word-preserving subtype realization on 2k+1 variables.
approaches.next_step: Use the terminal converse for genuine lower bounds or a terminal decision theorem; the nonterminal arbitrary-annotation converse is still open.

approaches.title: Make NO certificates complete
approaches.summary: A six-state nonflat NO language has an all-length arithmetic certificate and defeats every candidate-covering regular separator decoration with a finite semantic-tail bound.
approaches.next_step: Generalize symbolic violating-cut selectors and prove case coverage; increasing finite-state separator memory alone is incomplete.

approaches.title: Exploit restrictions shared by actual summary automata
approaches.summary: The terminal branch realizes arbitrary abstract flags; a nine-variable system has a nonregular terminal separating language. Flat terminal graphs are decidable arithmetically.
approaches.next_step: Target nonflat productive terminal components; shared B/A/D structure alone cannot exclude terminal abstract instances.

approaches.title: Apply cap and period-language saturation techniques
approaches.summary: Related sources have been read; no new saturation reduction has been built.

approaches.title: Strengthen truncation using occurrence context
approaches.summary: Proved three context refinements and formalized the binary visited-state rule; strict examples and exhaustive two-state checks pass.
approaches.next_step: Use the visited-state summary to classify shortest witnesses resisting every admissible cut in A008.

approaches.title: Implement and audit fixed-skeleton checkability
approaches.summary: Implemented exact Presburger skeleton formulas and a finite complete cover for flat terminal graphs; unbounded loop counts are retained.
approaches.next_step: Audit and formalize the arithmetic translation; extend bounded-skeleton coverage to nonflat terminal components without treating timeouts as NO.

approaches.title: Bound essential repeated blocks
approaches.summary: G-specific synchronized semantic tails were combined and tested locally; a six-state NO instance refutes completeness of candidate-covering regular separator decoration plus finite tails. A same-day strategy review selects the terminal small-model route bottom-up by flag structure and reduces the single-source subcase to bounding the primitive-root length of a near-periodic shape (exact census through five states).
approaches.next_step: Prove a G-specific existence-preserving word normalization or complete symbolic cover that may change or discard candidates with justification. For the single-source subcase, close the root-length step (primitivity under synchronised window deletion and border correspondence).

approaches.title: Work backwards from an executable Lean theorem
approaches.summary: Lean checks direct budget predicates, reversal, and an exact two-state decision, in addition to the previous truncation and conditional proofs.
approaches.next_step: Formalize the finite Sufficient automaton and its exact nonemptiness procedure; the global bound remains open.
